tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the PowerBankPortatil catalog (magnetic MagSafe-compatible power banks and magnetic phone cases). Returns name, price in EUR, stock, slug and URL of each match. All filters are optional; no filter returns the whole catalog.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get one product's name, price, stock, colour, capacity, image and URL by slug (any language), SKU or product id.

tools.name: check_phone_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether the magnetic power bank attaches to a phone model directly or needs a magnetic case, whether the phone charges wirelessly, and whether the store sells a case for it.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Exact shipping cost in EUR for a basket, computed with the checkout's rule (one power bank €5, 2–5 power banks free; a case is free with a power bank, €2 alone). Same rate for every country.

tools.name: get_store_policies
tools.description: Shipping prices, delivery time, returns, warranty and payment methods of the store (same rules as the checkout).
